senses.gloss: √raś\nSuch a root inferable from the derivatives:raśanā́ V.+ raśmán RV. raśmí V.+ rāśí V.+

√ras 'roar'
present: [1.] rasati rasate etc. B.+ 
perfect: rarāsa resus etc. E.+ 
[aorist: arīrasat arasīt arāsīt rasiṣyati rasitā ]
verbal: rasita 
[verbal: rāras- rirasiṣa- rāsaya- ]
derivatives: rasana rasitṛ C. 
Compare √1rās.
The root 2ras 'taste' is only a denominative of rasa.

√rās1 'roar'
present: [1.] rāsati rāsate etc. E.+ 
perfect: rarāse 
[aorist: arāsiṣṭa rāsiṣyate rāsitā ]

derivatives: rāsa? rā́sabha? B.+
